data.title: Launch hivemind: publish npm package, register MCP, plugin marketplace

evidence: npx -y hivemind-agents@0.1.0 install worked from registry; package.json shows version 0.1.1; npm view shows name='hivemind-agents' version='0.1.1' dist-tags.latest='0.1.1'; curl to registry shows 'io.github.Leonhest/hivemind version 0.1.1 active'; docker shows 'hivemind installed' with hooks + MCP f

data.text: Future releases: stage the package with npm's stage publish command, then the maintainer (Leon) approves via passkey on npmjs.com. This avoids 2FA codes in chat or tokens in version control.
data.rationale: npm deprecated TOTP and token-bypass methods; passkey is the only option, and staged publishing is npm's workflow for it.

evidence: User ran `npm profile enable-2fa auth-and-writes` → 'Adding a new TOTP 2FA is no longer supported' 404; Leo then used `npx npm@latest stage publish` twice successfully; approval via iPhone passkey worked; PLAN.md documents this

data.spec: MCP server name in registry.modelcontextprotocol.io must be exactly `io.github.Leonhest/hivemind` (case-sensitive). Must also match mcpName field in package.json and server.json. Registry publish fails with 403 if name doesn't match account username case (`Leonhest` not `leonhest`).

evidence: mcp-publisher publish with lowercase name → 403 'You have permission to publish: io.github.Leonhest/*'; fixed by updating mcpName to 'io.github.Leonhest/hivemind' in package.json and server.json; v0.1.1 published successfully; curl to registry confirms 'io.github.Leonhest/hivemind'
